_comment: Deliberately malformed. Dates and numbers arrive as prose, sentinels, wrong types, and impossible calendar values. The valid-but-unusual forms in the second record (epoch seconds, Postgres offset, comma-free decimal string) must still coerce, so a test that only asserts 'nothing threw' cannot pass by accident.

data.question: Does an unparseable date kill the record?
Do the odd-but-valid date forms still coerce?
